channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: US imposes sanctions on DR Congo ex-President Kabila alleging rebel support
item.description: The US imposed sanctions on former DR Congo President Kabila for allegedly supporting rebels. The former leader has not responded to US accusations that he is aiming to destabilise the government.

item.title: Hegseth says clock paused on deadline to seek approval for Iran war
item.description: US Defence Secretary Hegseth announced that the deadline for seeking approval for Iran war has been paused. The ceasefire will stop the clock for the president to report to Congress.

item.title: Pentagon Signs Deals With 7 AI Companies, Anthropic Not On List
item.description: The Pentagon signed deals with 7 AI companies, excluding Anthropic, deemed a supply-chain risk. The Pentagon agreement comes weeks after it designated Antrhopic as a supply-chain risk. (File). Pentagon Signs Deals With 7 AI Companies, Anthropic Not On List.

item.title: Iran has sent latest proposal to U.S. via Pakistan, state media reports
item.description: The UAE expressed distrust in Iran over Hormuz, hindering peace efforts. The Trump administration previously stated its war in Iran had been 'terminated' before a 60-day deadline. Trump administration says its war in Iran has been ’terminated’ before 60-day deadline.

item.title: Taiwan expresses concern after China calls island biggest risk in U.S.-China relations
item.description: Taiwan expressed concern after China called it the biggest risk in US-China relations. The call came about two weeks ahead of a highly anticipated summit between U. S. President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping, in which Taiwan is expected to be one of the key topics.

item.title: Iran offers latest proposal to U.S. via Pakistan: state media
item.description: Iran offered a proposal to the US via Pakistan, according to state media. The lack of fighting has not assuaged markets, with oil prices still more than 50% above their prewar levels as traders confront a prolonged closure of Hormuz.

item.title: Woman killed, children injured as Israel attacks Lebanon
item.description: Israel attacked Lebanon, killing a woman and injuring children, despite a US-brokered ceasefire. Israel's assault, which has displaced more than one people in Lebanon, escalates despite US brokered 'ceasefire'. Woman killed, children injured as Israel attacks Lebanon.

item.title: Why cutting US troops in Europe won’t be easy
item.description: Trump threatened to reduce US troops in Germany amid tensions over the Iran war. Amid transatlantic tensions over the Iran war, Trump has threatened to reduce troops in Germany. Why cutting US troops in Europe won’t be easy.

item.title: Taiwan After China Calls Taipei Biggest Risk In Ties With US
item.description: China called Taiwan the biggest risk in US ties without confirming or denying allegations. China did not confirm nor deny the allegations. (File). Taiwan After China Calls Taipei Biggest Risk In Ties With US.

item.title: 'Don't Accept Imposition, Don't Want War': Iran Says Open To Talk To US
item.description: Iran is open to talks with the US after stalled negotiations and a naval blockade. Talks have since stalled as the United States imposed a naval blockade on Iranian ports.

item.title: ‘Turbulent and dangerous’: How shipping is the new global battleground
item.description: Geopolitics is changing global shipping rules from Hormuz to the South China Sea. From Hormuz to Panama, the South China Sea to the Black Sea, geopolitics is rewriting the rules of global shipping.

item.title: Iran offers new proposal amid stalled US peace talks
item.description: Iran handed a new proposal to Pakistan on Thursday evening, according to Iranian state media, amid stalled US peace talks. The text of the proposal was handed to mediator Pakistan on Thursday (Apr 30) evening, Iranian state media reported.

item.title: Iran Crisis Making Delivery Of Relief Aid To Refugees Costly : UN Agency
item.description: Aid shipments detour around Africa's Cape of Good Hope due to the Iran crisis. Aid shipments now detour around Africa's Cape of Good Hope, increasing transit times. Iran Crisis Making Delivery Of Relief Aid To Refugees Costly: UN Agency.

item.title: Iran Delivers New Proposal For Talks With US Via Pakistan
item.description: The US received a new proposal for talks with Iran via Pakistan, marking a potential shift in diplomatic efforts. The proposal's details remain unclear, but it suggests a willingness to engage in negotiations.

item.title: White House says truce delays 60-day deadline
item.description: The White House announced that a truce in the Iran conflict delays the 60-day deadline for a resolution. The exact implications of the delay are still unclear, but it may impact ongoing diplomatic efforts.

item.title: Strain on food, fuel and aid systems continues
item.description: The Middle East crisis strains global food, fuel, and aid systems. The strain on food, fuel and aid systems worldwide continues as the the Middle East crisis deepens. Rising oil prices, supply disruptions and mounting transport costs are affecting humanitarian operations and access to essential goods far beyond the region.

item.title: How US naval blockade is quietly suffocating Iran’s economy
item.description: The US naval blockade has significantly strained Iran's economy, with reports suggesting a substantial decline in trade and revenue. The blockade's impact on Iran's economy is a key factor in the ongoing conflict.

item.title: Top Five Moments Of King Charles III With Trump During US Visit
item.description: King Charles III used humor during a state dinner with Trump, referencing historical events and global issues in a lighthearted manner. The exchange highlighted the diplomatic efforts between the two leaders during the US visit.

item.title: 'Treacherous Aggression': UAE Says Iran Cannot Be Trusted Over Hormuz
item.description: The UAE has expressed distrust towards Iran over the Strait of Hormuz, calling its actions "treacherous aggression." The Iranian blockade has largely closed the strategic waterway. Strait Of Hormuz remains largely closed because of an Iranian blockade.

item.title: Is Myanmar's military winning the civil war?
item.description: Myanmar's military is stemming losses and reclaiming territory after five years of war with armed resistance groups. After five years of war, armed resistance groups still challenge Myanmar's military across much of the country.
